property_summary: For every call to transfer with a callee that reverts, the reference contract C always propagates that revert (so transfer itself reverts), whereas the mutant inverts the success check and will continue (not revert) when the callee reverts — thus the universal rule is: when the external transferFrom call fails, C.transfer must revert; the mutant violates this for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert the success check so that if the external call succeeds the function reverts, and it proceeds when the call fails.
